findings.finding: F07 FrozenDelivery I26 response changes canonicalKey/sequence without a Delivery write
findings.impact: For the same deliveryId/messageId/payload bytes, I26 returns F07:I26 / 4, while persisted Delivery and I25 return F07:OWNER-SEQUENCE / 3. findings.exit_condition: Specify and align the FrozenDelivery projection and canonical identity; repair fixture response/digests or document a distinct, typed attempt identity.
